instructions.instruction: Synthesize clean, robust, vectorized Python strategy code using pandas and numpy.

Enforce strict AST Security Sandbox rules: - Whitelisted modules only: pandas, numpy, math, typing, datetime. - Forbidden calls: os, sys, subprocess, eval, exec, open, compile, __import__, socket, requests, httpx.

Standard Strategy Template Structure: - class StrategyEngine: calculates vector signal Series: 1 (BUY), -1 (SELL), 0 (HOLD). - Incorporate dynamic parameters: rsi_upper, rsi_lower, use_trend, use_volume.
